== Original post ==

'''There Will Be Now One To Stop Us This Time'''
* '''Author:''' Dan "Yoda84" Mochizuki
* '''Published:''' September 1, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This is a mains and toys deck that canadapt to and beat almost any light deck.

=== Strategy ===

This is a mains and toys deck with certain variations which I think enables it to beat most light decks. I start with Jabba's Palace and choose my interrupt based on what my opponent is playing. Against Operatives I start with Battle Order, against Hidden Base i start with Resistance, and against anything else I start with Combat Readiness for the Cantina. Then, basically establish drains on the ground and battle your opponent wherever they are. I included Endor because I think it is a great system (you drain for 2, opponent drains for 1) and can tip the scales in my favor vs. another ground deck if I can set up a drain there.
